# SYNESIS_E151 — Warning

## Description

`old_name` is already a label of `TARGET`.

## Severity

This diagnostic is **local to an `EXPORT` block**. When compiling it is reported as a warning and the corpus still compiles; in `synesis export` it stops that block (that artifact is not written) and the other blocks run.

## Compiler message

```text
`EXPORT <FORMAT> <name>`: the alias name `old_name` is already a label of `TARGET`;
  it was not repeated (the labels of a concept are disjoint, SKOS S13).
```
